discovery.progress: {files, plural, =0 {No files} one {# file} other {# files}} scanned so far
discovery.cancelled: Discovery was cancelled; no snapshot was saved.
discovery.partial: Partial scan: discovery reached a declared limit.
discovery.warning.unreadable: Could not read “{path}”; it was skipped.
discovery.warning.symlinkOutside: The symbolic link “{path}” points outside the project; it was not followed.
discovery.warning.symlinkDirNotFollowed: The symbolic link “{path}” points to a folder; discovery does not follow folder links.
discovery.warning.partialScan: Partial scan ({reasons}): {entries} entries were read, then discovery stopped at the limit.
discovery.warning.configTooLarge: The configuration file “{path}” is larger than the limit; it was not read.
discovery.warning.configInvalid: The configuration file “{path}” is invalid; checks that depend on it may be unavailable.
discovery.sensitive.named: “{path}” was recorded by name only; its values were not read.
discovery.warning.symlinkTargetSkipped: The symbolic link “{path}” points to a file discovery does not read (skipped, ignored, or not a regular file); it was not read.
discovery.warning.gitignoreTruncated: “{path}” has {rules} rules; only the first thousand were read.
